method.primary: All 127 client token gaps per background request, then requests, then 3 repeats; SD across repeats.
method.event: Offset zero is first prefill chunk. Exact background output-token ordinal matched to same-repeat decode-only. Exclude local client intervals touching bundled SSE; retain all chunks in model metrics and all requests in whole-request TPOT.
method.max_client_gap: Mean across requests of the largest observed SSE token-event arrival interval; bundled events do not resolve individual model-step gaps.
method.limitations: Two sequential budget blocks; 3 repeats; single 4090/Qwen; caption control is a literal interpretation, not confirmed paper workload.

h16k-b2048.batch_zero_policy: prefill-only full/append; no decode baseline or decode TPOT
h16k-b2048.replicate_aggregation: mean TPOT across background decode requests within each trial
h16k-b2048.cache_isolation: independent cache_salt for each role/trial; same logical prompts across three scenarios within a repeat/batch
h16k-b2048.clock: time.perf_counter_ns; same dcn10 kernel as scheduler trace
h16k-b2048.failure_policy: retain all raw evidence; finish in-flight requests, stop on failed trial; no retry
h16k-b2048.http_connections: force_close=True; a fresh TCP connection for every request avoids stale keep-alive reuse
h16k-b2048.artifact_persistence: buffer during active inference; flush after all in-flight requests finish
